meta.field: Medical Image Analysis / Compressed Sensing MRI
innovations: Proposed Linear Mamba Operator (LMO), the first Mamba-based Neural Operator for MRI reconstruction, combining Scanning Integration (SI) and Convolution Integration (CI) to capture global and local features.
Proved Continuous-Discrete Equivalence (CDE) for SI and CI in bandlimited function spaces, theoretically ensuring the model's generalization ability.
LMO demonstrated superior generalization across varying acceleration rates (AR), being the only model that achieves retraining performance without retraining when AR changes.
